opening.argument: The presentation is centered on explaining alternative investment funds and their types, as its title makes clear: “Understanding Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) & their types.” The discussion identifies these subjects as the video’s main topics and explains features including the INR 1 crore minimum investment, angel-fund investing, and complex strategies involving leverage. It also expressly characterizes the material as “just an educational video” and advises ordinary investors that “it's better to avoid such products.” Against that educational and cautionary framing, the brief mention that viewers can subscribe to model portfolios and find offers on the website is ancillary to the discussion, which is not presented as sponsored by an AIF.
